plot: At 4 a.m. on Mia's birthday the new puppy cries in its basket on the kitchen floor; Lolly's lullaby makes it howl and Crispy's warmth isn't enough, so Bup dares scared Pim to sleep in the basket, and Pim realizes the puppy misses its mother's heartbeat — like the quiet it got when the wind-up timer ticked beside it — so the bros wrap the ticking timer in a towel and the puppy sleeps, but at six the basket is empty and tiny paw prints lead to the table where Mom left the birthday cake.

script.title: Bup Dared Pim to Sleep in the Puppys Bed

beats.say: Why won't the puppy stop crying? It's been crying for hours!
Cover your ears, Pim! And keep your voice down!
Four in the morning. The puppy's basket sits on the floor.
If Mia hears this, her birthday surprise is ruined. Totally ruined.
Basic checklist. Hungry? Its bowl is full. Cold? It has a blanket.
Zeek bumps the old kitchen timer. It rolls over, ticking.
For three seconds, the puppy goes quiet.
See? It's calming down. It needs music. Let me sing.
Hush little puppy, don't you cry, Lolly will sing you a...
It's howling with you. It thinks you're a dog.
I am a professional cookie! I do not howl!
Technically, you howled first. Then it joined in.
Upstairs, a bed creaked! Somebody's waking up!
If Mom comes down now, she finds the puppy and us!
The creak stops. Somebody just rolled over. Everybody breathes.
I'll try. Puppies like warm things. I'm the warmest thing here.
Crispy sits by the basket. The crying gets softer. It doesn't stop.
Warm isn't enough. It wants something I don't have.
Maybe it's the dark. Let's open the fridge door a crack.
Bad idea. Fridges beep when they're left open.
The fridge beeps. The puppy cries louder. Now with beeping.
Then somebody has to sleep right next to it. Inside the basket.
Pim. I dare you. Sleep in the puppy's basket tonight.
Me? I'm scared of the dark! Of the fridge hum! Of spoons!
That's exactly why, Pim. You know what scared feels like.
Okay. Okay. If I faint, put me back in my jar.
Deal. And I'll never call you a scaredy-bean again.
Pim climbs into the basket. A huge, wet puppy nose sniffs him.
Hi. I'm Pim. I'm also terrified. We can be terrified together.
Look. It's shaking too. Both of them are shaking.
The puppy presses its ear against Pim's chest. And gets quiet.
It's listening to my heartbeat. My silly, fast heartbeat.
It's not scared of the dark. It misses its mom's heartbeat.
When I left my bean jar, I missed the rattling. Every night.
Oh, Pim. You never told us that.
But you can't stay in that basket forever, Pim.
I don't have to. Remember? It went quiet for the ticking!
Ticking sounds like a heartbeat! Wrap it in a dish towel!
Bup and Zeek roll the timer, wrapped in a towel, inside.
The puppy curls around it. One tiny sigh. Then nothing. Asleep.
Pim, the scaredest bean in the kitchen, just saved the birthday.
Brave isn't not being scared. Brave is lying next to it anyway.
I was so brave. I need a very long nap.
Pim falls asleep beside the puppy. The sun starts to rise.
At six, Pim wakes up. The basket is empty.
Where's the puppy? Guys! Tiny paw prints! Going to the table!
The table? That's where Mom left Mia's birthday cake!

long.title: Bup Dared Pim to Sleep in the Puppy's Bed 🐶
long.description:
"I'm scared of everything. That's why I knew what it needed." — Pim
The new puppy won't stop crying in the kitchen at 4 a.m., and if Mia hears it, her birthday surprise is ruined. Lolly's lullaby backfires, so Bup dares the most scared bean of all. Did your puppy cry on its first night too? 👇
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: Bup retó a Pim a dormir en la cama del cachorro 🐶
es.description:
"Le tengo miedo a todo. Por eso supe lo que necesitaba." — Pim
El cachorro nuevo no deja de llorar en la cocina a las 4 a. m., y si Mia lo oye, su sorpresa de cumpleaños se arruina. La nana de Lolly sale fatal, así que Bup reta al frijol más miedoso de todos. ¿Tu cachorro también lloró la primera noche? 👇
#serie #animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Bup desafiou Pim a dormir na caminha do filhote 🐶
pt.description:
"Eu tenho medo de tudo. Por isso eu sabia do que ele precisava." — Pim
O filhote novo não para de chorar na cozinha às 4 da manhã, e se a Mia ouvir, a surpresa de aniversário acaba. A canção de ninar da Lolly dá errado, então o Bup desafia o feijão mais medroso de todos. Seu filhote também chorou na primeira noite? 👇
#série #animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: باب يتحدى بيم أن ينام في سرير الجرو 🐶
ar.description:
"أنا أخاف من كل شيء. لهذا عرفت ما يحتاجه." — بيم
الجرو الجديد لا يتوقف عن البكاء في المطبخ في الرابعة فجرًا، وإن سمعته ميا فستفسد مفاجأة عيد ميلادها. تهويدة لولي تأتي بنتيجة عكسية، فيتحدى باب أكثر حبة فاصولياء خوفًا. هل بكى جروك في ليلته الأولى أيضًا؟ 👇
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Bup défie Pim de dormir dans le lit du chiot 🐶
fr.description:
« J'ai peur de tout. C'est pour ça que j'ai su ce qu'il lui fallait. » — Pim
Le nouveau chiot pleure sans arrêt dans la cuisine à 4 h du matin, et si Mia l'entend, la surprise d'anniversaire est fichue. La berceuse de Lolly tourne mal, alors Bup lance un défi au haricot le plus peureux de tous. Votre chiot a pleuré la première nuit aussi ? 👇
#série #animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: バップの挑戦：ピム、子犬のベッドで寝られる？🐶
ja.description:
「ぼくは何でもこわい。だから、この子に必要なものがわかったんだ。」— ピム
朝4時、新しい子犬がキッチンで泣きやまない。ミアに聞こえたら誕生日サプライズは台なし。ロリーの子守歌は逆効果。そこでバップは、いちばんこわがりの豆に挑戦状を出す。きみの子犬も最初の夜は泣いた？👇
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 밥의 도전: 핌, 강아지 침대에서 잘 수 있어? 🐶
ko.description:
"난 모든 게 무서워. 그래서 얘한테 뭐가 필요한지 알았어." — 핌
새벽 4시, 새 강아지가 부엌에서 울음을 멈추지 않는다. 미아가 들으면 생일 깜짝 선물은 끝이다. 롤리의 자장가는 역효과, 그래서 밥은 가장 겁 많은 콩에게 도전장을 내민다. 너희 강아지도 첫날 밤에 울었어? 👇
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Bup fordert Pim heraus: im Welpenbett schlafen 🐶
de.description:
„Ich habe vor allem Angst. Deshalb wusste ich, was er braucht.“ — Pim
Der neue Welpe hört um 4 Uhr morgens in der Küche nicht auf zu weinen, und wenn Mia ihn hört, ist die Geburtstagsüberraschung dahin. Lollys Schlaflied geht nach hinten los, also fordert Bup die ängstlichste Bohne von allen heraus. Hat dein Welpe in der ersten Nacht auch geweint? 👇
#serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
